references.context: Shoot the raised wall scoop to collect the offered item.
references.label: Raised item scoop
references.description: One scoop in the moving wall rises after a standup-target or captive-ball hit.

references.context: Hit any one of the four standup targets or the captive ball.
references.label: Captive ball
references.description: The captive ball is one of the five shots that selects a wall scoop.
